entry.title: New: Resolution 602 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — GOEAC-148: Recommended adoption - 07/22/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR, NATIONAL PARK SERVICE, FOR INTERAGENCY PUBLIC SAFETY COORDINATION

Establishes a working relationship between the National Park Service and Hawaiʻi Fire Department to allow for the coordination of personnel, services, equipment, and facilities required for the protection of life and properties during emergency incidents.
